title: Analytically controlled single-reservoir Ribasim surrogate
purpose: Create a deterministic research and verification harness for Ribasim-like Basin storage/level, forecast allocation, physical realization of MODFLOW-derived infiltration/drainage, UserDemand delivery and shortage before coupling to real Ribasim.
scope: one Basin with a linear volume-stage relation
explicit committed, allocation-candidate and physical-realization state
forecast Basin external inflow, drainage and infiltration
actual Basin external inflow, drainage and infiltration
UserDemand request, allocated volume, realized delivery and split shortage accounting
UserDemand min_level represented exactly through the linear Basin profile
priority_contract: allocation is a prediction from committed Basin state and forecast forcing
physical realization applies actual Basin drainage and infiltration before determining realizable UserDemand delivery
actual infiltration is not silently reduced to satisfy a previously allocated UserDemand
if actual mandatory infiltration exceeds physically available Basin water, realization fails closed
realized UserDemand may be lower than allocation when actual hydrology is less favorable than forecast
transaction_contract: planning a step does not mutate committed state
a candidate is bound to the committed revision from which it was prepared

experiments.E1: forecast equals realization: full UserDemand delivery with exact mass closure
experiments.E2: late conflict: allocation sees enough water, but larger realized Basin infiltration creates realization shortage
experiments.E3: UserDemand min_level constrains allocation while mandatory physical infiltration remains uncurtailed
experiments.E4: physically infeasible realized infiltration fails closed with zero committed-state mutation
experiments.E6: linear Basin stage-volume mapping is exactly invertible within numerical precision

forbidden: no claim that the surrogate reproduces Ribasim network routing or allocation semantics
no silent hydrological-flux curtailment to make the balance feasible

mapped_concepts: allocation prediction followed by attempted physical realization
BMI-facing writable infiltration, drainage and demand variables
ribasim_alignment.non_claim: The dummy does not reproduce Ribasim network optimization, routing, adaptive timestepping or solver behavior.
